verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a cloud file-storage product, but the evidence pack shows no documented bulk or batch capability. Graph does not cover them here: no $batch or JSON batching appears, and no multi-item move, copy, delete or share operation is described. The cited APIs (createLink, put-content, upload sessions) act on a single driveItem. Search and delta query return or track many items but are reads and change tracking, not bulk actions, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
